```{=html}
<div style="display:flex; justify-content:center; margin: 1.5em 0;">
<svg width="660" height="370" style="max-width:100%; height:auto;" viewBox="0 0 660 370" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Piping system. Water leaves a tank through a sharp-edged entrance into horizontal pipe section 1 (diameter D1, length L1), turns upward at a 90 degree threaded elbow into vertical section 2 (D2, L2), which contains a pump, turns right at a second 90 degree threaded elbow into horizontal section 3 (D3, L3), which contains a half-open gate valve, then passes through a sudden expansion into the wider section 4 (D4, L4) and exits. A gravity vector g points downward in the corner.">
  <defs>
    <marker id="pl-arrow-red" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#e0311f"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="pl-arrow-blue" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#1f77e0"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="pl-arrow-green" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#1f8a3a"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="pl-arrow-purple" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#8a3fd1"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="pl-arrow-black" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- opaque background so the diagram stays legible in dark mode too -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="660" height="370" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- tank -->
  <rect x="20" y="182" width="90" height="148" fill="#a8e4f0"/>
  <g stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none">
    <path d="M 20 160 L 20 330 L 110 330 L 110 309"/>
    <path d="M 110 291 L 110 160"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="182" x2="110" y2="182" stroke="#1f77e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 58 170 L 72 170 L 65 180 Z" fill="none" stroke="#1f77e0" stroke-width="1.3"/>

  <!-- water in the pipe -->
  <polygon points="110,291 250,291 250,72 440,72 440,90 268,90 268,309 110,309" fill="#a8e4f0"/>
  <rect x="440" y="66" width="160" height="30" fill="#a8e4f0"/>

  <!-- pipe walls: sections 1-3 (centerline 110,300 -> 259,300 -> 259,81 -> 440,81), then the wider section 4 -->
  <g stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="miter">
    <path d="M 110 309 L 268 309 L 268 90 L 440 90 L 440 96 L 600 96"/>
    <path d="M 110 291 L 250 291 L 250 72 L 440 72 L 440 66 L 600 66"/>
  </g>

  <!-- gate valve on section 3 -->
  <g stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2" fill="#ffffff">
    <path d="M 345 64 L 360 81 L 345 98 Z"/>
    <path d="M 375 64 L 360 81 L 375 98 Z"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2">
    <line x1="360" y1="81" x2="360" y2="54"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="54" x2="369" y2="54"/>
  </g>

  <!-- pump on the vertical section (circle with triangle pointing in the flow direction) -->
  <circle cx="259" cy="160" r="17" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M 249 168 L 269 168 L 259 148 Z" fill="#1a1a1a"/>
  <line x1="205" y1="150" x2="239" y2="157" stroke="#8a3fd1" stroke-width="1.2" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-purple)"/>
  <text x="200" y="152" font-size="13" fill="#8a3fd1" text-anchor="end">pump</text>

  <!-- flow direction -->
  <line x1="130" y1="300" x2="165" y2="300" stroke="#1f77e0" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-blue)"/>
  <line x1="606" y1="81" x2="642" y2="81" stroke="#1f77e0" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-blue)"/>

  <!-- lengths (red dimension lines, measured along the centerline) -->
  <g stroke="#e0311f" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none">
    <line x1="110" y1="345" x2="259" y2="345" marker-start="url(#pl-arrow-red)" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="310" y1="81" x2="310" y2="300" marker-start="url(#pl-arrow-red)" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="259" y1="30" x2="440" y2="30" marker-start="url(#pl-arrow-red)" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="440" y1="30" x2="600" y2="30" marker-start="url(#pl-arrow-red)" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <!-- extension lines -->
    <line x1="259" y1="315" x2="259" y2="352" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
    <line x1="274" y1="300" x2="316" y2="300" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
    <line x1="259" y1="24" x2="259" y2="66" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
    <line x1="440" y1="24" x2="440" y2="60" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
    <line x1="600" y1="24" x2="600" y2="60" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#e0311f" font-size="16">
    <text x="176" y="364" text-anchor="middle"><tspan font-style="italic">L</tspan><tspan dy="4" font-size="11">1</tspan></text>
    <text x="316" y="196"><tspan font-style="italic">L</tspan><tspan dy="4" font-size="11">2</tspan></text>
    <text x="350" y="22" text-anchor="middle"><tspan font-style="italic">L</tspan><tspan dy="4" font-size="11">3</tspan></text>
    <text x="520" y="22" text-anchor="middle"><tspan font-style="italic">L</tspan><tspan dy="4" font-size="11">4</tspan></text>
  </g>

  <!-- diameters (arrows pointing at the walls) -->
  <g stroke="#e0311f" stroke-width="1.3">
    <line x1="205" y1="270" x2="205" y2="289" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="205" y1="330" x2="205" y2="311" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="226" y1="208" x2="248" y2="208" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="292" y1="208" x2="270" y2="208" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="410" y1="48" x2="410" y2="70" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="410" y1="114" x2="410" y2="92" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="560" y1="44" x2="560" y2="64" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
    <line x1="560" y1="118" x2="560" y2="98" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-red)"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#e0311f" font-size="16">
    <text x="211" y="276"><tspan font-style="italic">D</tspan><tspan dy="4" font-size="11">1</tspan></text>
    <text x="200" y="213"><tspan font-style="italic">D</tspan><tspan dy="4" font-size="11">2</tspan></text>
    <text x="416" y="118"><tspan font-style="italic">D</tspan><tspan dy="4" font-size="11">3</tspan></text>
    <text x="566" y="122"><tspan font-style="italic">D</tspan><tspan dy="4" font-size="11">4</tspan></text>
  </g>

  <!-- minor loss elements, labeled in words -->
  <g stroke="#1f8a3a" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="132" y1="258" x2="113" y2="288" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-green)"/>
    <line x1="290" y1="326" x2="270" y2="312" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-green)"/>
    <line x1="215" y1="58" x2="247" y2="70" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-green)"/>
    <line x1="360" y1="128" x2="360" y2="101" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-green)"/>
    <line x1="470" y1="150" x2="443" y2="100" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-green)"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#1f8a3a" font-size="13">
    <text x="118" y="252">sharp-edged entrance</text>
    <text x="294" y="336">90° threaded elbow</text>
    <text x="210" y="56" text-anchor="end">90° threaded elbow</text>
    <text x="360" y="142" text-anchor="middle">gate valve (half open)</text>
    <text x="474" y="162">sudden expansion</text>
  </g>

  <!-- gravity -->
  <line x1="620" y1="270" x2="620" y2="330" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#pl-arrow-black)"/>
  <text x="630" y="306" font-size="17" font-style="italic" fill="#1a1a1a">g</text>
</svg>
</div>
```
